identity.description:
Add the E3b and E4 notes of D4c and the time figures of E3, E3b and E4

## Summary

The E3b and E4 notes of D4c, the time figures of E3, E3b and E4, and both experiments marked done in TICKETS.md. Notes only: no code and no default change, so no version bump.

- **E3b** (`docs/research/e3b-severity-step.md`): the severity stays in the verifier. No split arm passes the rule. The best arm, a step on Opus 5.5 medium for each finding, agrees on post against no post in 0.899 of the findings, against 0.835 for the single call. But the lower end of its 90% interval is exactly 0.000, and the rule needs it above zero. The truth check agreed on 30 of 30 candidates. The note states the labeler limit (the goldens were labeled by Opus with a Sol judge) and a possible cache saving (the policy before the finding).
- **E4** (`docs/research/e4-score-scale.md`): the score from 0 to 100 stays. With the map from a band to a score chosen before the run, the five bands lose 0.208 posted recall and put more results in the band. The note also decides the stored results again under other maps, with no model call. A map chosen after the figures would pass the rule, and the note gives it as a hypothesis for a later run. In both scales, the share of real candidates is about one third from 70 up.
- **Time** (E3, E3b and E4 notes): the time of each call from the stored durations, and the S1 review time from `cost.stage_ms`: a median of 1.7 min, from 0.4 to 3.9 min. The escalation is 43% of the verifier call time in the median case. Opus 5.5 low verifies in about half the time of Sonnet 5.5 medium.

## Spend

E3b cost $55.36 and E4 cost $19.84 on the plan login. The extra figures of the notes made no model call.
